summaries.name: Slack
summaries.summary: Slack is suggested as a platform to create or join informal chat groups with colleagues for non-work-related conversations while working remotely.

summaries.name: Microsoft Teams
summaries.summary: Microsoft Teams is suggested as a platform to create or join informal chat groups with colleagues for non-work-related conversations while working remotely.

summaries.name: Zoom
summaries.summary: Zoom is suggested as the video conferencing platform to use for scheduling a weekly virtual coffee break with a remote team.
